risks.detail: Plan concentrates capacity toward worst neighborhoods; monitor any emerging tail delays in mid-tier areas.
If arrivals spike by ~20%, backlog delta may exceed constitution cap. Recommend enabling crisis-mode efficiency bonus or reducing shift by 2–3 pts.

mitigations: Add weekly audit: check max_harm_pct and backlog_delta_pct; auto-reduce capacity_shift_pct if thresholds approach limits.
Run chaos stress tests (demand spike, capacity drop) before adopting policy.
